name: shared-helper-export-syntax
goal: Recognize standalone exported helper arrows without mistaking parenthesized values for functions.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Typed and single-parameter exported arrows are helpers; parenthesized values, private functions, types and class methods are not.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: History projection covers named functions. The generated metadata unit needs a reusable source-shape matrix for arrow declarations, non-callable exports, shared versus feature-local paths, revision changes and missing files.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: 3dd02df7: unchanged metadata source-shape matrix fails: typed and single-parameter arrows are missing and a parenthesized constant is falsely callable.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Export scanning reads past variable type annotations and checks for the arrow token; parenthesized value expressions remain constants. Both parenthesized and single-parameter helper arrows retain their signatures.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: 83f6c459 passes the unchanged source-shape matrix after failure at 3dd02df7. Typed and single-argument arrows appear; values, private functions, classes and feature-local paths do not. Missing historical files remain explicit gaps.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Reports workspace check passed: 596 tests, formatting, typecheck, lint, three builds and audit. All 30 related browser cases pass, with no unexpected browser diagnostics. Root formatting, typecheck, lint, kernel checks/build and 854 unit tests passed (25 live cases skipped). The full root check was interrupted during broader E2E after 13 passing cases, so full cross-platform verification remains pending; no native UI testing or main merge. Exact-commit history integration and immutable red/green pairs are recorded separately. Live preview 5688 verified helper search, schema exclusion and owner-history links. Cached projections were enriched from exact Git commits without changing prior records, media or other fields. Logs: /tmp/harness-helpers-reports-final-check.log, /tmp/harness-helpers-browser-final.log, /tmp/harness-helpers-root-check.log.
